_rule: Document B section 6. Every value here comes from a verified source, named below. Nothing is inferred and nothing is guessed. A missing value is reported, never filled in.

sources.schedule: Supabase event_calendar joined to events, project jlwopomkqeawrxlapwpc, read 26 September 2026. Supplies event, day, date and first-bout time.
sources.cutoff: events.booking_cutoff_minutes, same read. First bout minus the cutoff, written onto each card as an absolute UTC instant.
sources.doors: MuayTix's own published day-dated pages in this repository, which carry an explicit doors attribute. Not derived and not offset from the first bout.
sources.destinations: Document A. Dated URL patterns are the ones already in use across the published day-dated pages.
sources.accents: The owner's spoken instruction of 27 September 2026, resolved to hex values already published on his own event pages in this repository. NOTE: event_calendar.accent_colour disagrees with him for four of the six events and is served live to the booking widget. It has NOT been changed from here.
sources.photographs: MuayTix's own Tilda CDN, already published across this repository's seating and event pages. Every alt line below is the owner's wording, copied from the page it already appears on. No photograph is described here.
sources.seat_colours: Seat class colours sampled from the owner's own seat map artwork and recorded in CLAUDE.md. Used as bars and swatches only. None of them is legible as type and none is ever set as type.
sources.short_names: event_calendar.short_name, project jlwopomkqeawrxlapwpc, read 27 September 2026. The owner's own short name for each event. Set as the label inside the accent field. Not abbreviated here.
sources.logos: Supplied directly by the owner, 27 September 2026. The files themselves cannot be opened from this environment, because static.tildacdn.com is blocked by the network policy, so nothing about how they look has been verified here.
sources.logo_tiles: Black. The All Star logo's own background reads #000000 in the owner's screen capture of 27 September 2026, and the Petchyindee logo is knocked out with mix-blend-mode: screen on its own page in this repository, which is done to a black background. The remaining four have not been seen. A logo drawn in dark artwork on transparency would be invisible on a black tile and needs a white one instead.
